summary: Chibisafe is a self-hosted file sharing service that provides instant links for uploaded content like photos and documents through a web interface. It relies on Node.js and is available as a container image for deployment on private infrastructure under an MIT licence.
goodFor: It suits individuals or small teams wanting a dedicated, self-hosted alternative to third-party file hosting services with drag-and-drop capabilities.
watchOut: Given the modest community engagement and at-risk maintenance status, you may need to patch bugs yourself if upstream updates stall.
deployNotes: You will typically need to configure persistent storage volumes for uploaded files and place the container behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
